package learningsession

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/curriculum"
)

type TeacherEnsurer interface {
	Execute(context.Context, string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error)
}

type DialogGateway interface {
	repository.TeacherDialogProvisioner
	repository.DialogTeacherProactiveAppender
}

type Summarizer struct {
	Teachers   TeacherEnsurer
	Sessions   repository.StudentLearningSessionGateway
	Analytics  repository.LearningAnalyticsSummaryReader
	Dialogs    DialogGateway
	Curriculum CurriculumReplanner
}

type CurriculumReplanner interface {
	ExecuteCurrent(context.Context, string, string, string, curriculum.PlanAuditRefs) (curriculum.PlanResult, error)
}

func (summarizer Summarizer) Execute(ctx context.Context, studentID, sessionID string) (domain.LearningSessionSummaryResult, error) {
	studentID, sessionID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID), strings.TrimSpace(sessionID)
	if summarizer.Teachers == nil || summarizer.Sessions == nil || summarizer.Analytics == nil || summarizer.Dialogs == nil || summarizer.Curriculum == nil {
		return domain.LearningSessionSummaryResult{}, domain.ErrInvalidLearningSessionSummary
	}
	teacher, err := summarizer.Teachers.Execute(ctx, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningSessionSummaryResult{}, err
	}
	session, err := summarizer.Sessions.GetLearningSession(ctx, studentID, sessionID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningSessionSummaryResult{}, err
	}
	if session.ID != sessionID || session.StudentID != studentID || session.EndedAt == nil || session.AnalyticsSessionID == "" {
		return domain.LearningSessionSummaryResult{}, domain.ErrInvalidLearningSessionSummary
	}
	analytics, err := summarizer.Analytics.GetLearningSessionSummary(ctx, studentID, session.AnalyticsSessionID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningSessionSummaryResult{}, err
	}
	analytics, err = domain.NormalizeLearningAnalyticsSummary(analytics, studentID, session.AnalyticsSessionID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningSessionSummaryResult{}, err
	}
	summary, nextStep, reasonCode := formulate(teacher.Language, analytics)
	body := summary + " " + nextStep
	binding, err := summarizer.Dialogs.EnsureTeacherDialog(ctx, studentID, teacher.ID, domain.LearningContextGeneral, "")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningSessionSummaryResult{}, err
	}
	message, err := summarizer.Dialogs.AppendTeacherProactive(ctx, binding, sessionID, body)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningSessionSummaryResult{}, err
	}
	updated, err := summarizer.Sessions.ApplyLearningSessionMetrics(ctx, studentID, sessionID, session.Version, analytics)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearningSessionSummaryResult{}, err
	}
	var planningRequestID string
	if session.CourseID != "" {
		plan, planErr := summarizer.Curriculum.ExecuteCurrent(ctx, studentID, session.CourseID, sessionID, curriculum.PlanAuditRefs{
			DialogID: binding.ID, SourceMessageID: message.ID,
		})
		if planErr != nil {
			return domain.LearningSessionSummaryResult{}, planErr
		}
		planningRequestID = plan.RequestID
	}
	return domain.LearningSessionSummaryResult{
		Session: updated, Analytics: analytics, Summary: summary, NextStep: nextStep,
		ReasonCode: reasonCode, PolicyVersion: domain.LearningSessionSummaryPolicyVersion,
		DialogID: binding.ID, MessageID: message.ID,
		PlanningRequestID: planningRequestID,
	}, nil
}

func formulate(language string, analytics domain.LearningAnalyticsSummary) (string, string, string) {
	minutes := (analytics.ActiveLearningSeconds + 59) / 60
	english := strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(language)), "en")
	if english {
		summary := fmt.Sprintf(
			"Session summary: %d active minutes, %d lessons and %d tasks completed, %d questions, %d code runs, %d failed checks, %d passed tests, and %d hints.",
			minutes, analytics.LessonCount, analytics.TaskCount, analytics.QuestionCount, analytics.CodeRunCount,
			analytics.FailureCount, analytics.PassedTestCount, analytics.HintCount,
		)
		next, reason := englishNextStep(analytics)
		return summary, next, reason
	}
	summary := fmt.Sprintf(
		"Итог занятия: %d активных минут, завершено уроков — %d, задач — %d, вопросов — %d, запусков кода — %d, неуспешных проверок — %d, успешных тестов — %d, подсказок — %d.",
		minutes, analytics.LessonCount, analytics.TaskCount, analytics.QuestionCount, analytics.CodeRunCount,
		analytics.FailureCount, analytics.PassedTestCount, analytics.HintCount,
	)
	next, reason := russianNextStep(analytics)
	return summary, next, reason
}

func englishNextStep(analytics domain.LearningAnalyticsSummary) (string, string) {
	switch {
	case analytics.StuckSignalCount > 0 || analytics.FailureCount > analytics.PassedTestCount:
		return "Next: revisit the difficult step and solve one short similar exercise before moving on.", "stuck_or_failure_review"
	case analytics.HintCount > 0:
		return "Next: repeat a similar exercise without hints to verify independent understanding.", "verify_independent_understanding"
	case analytics.LessonCount+analytics.TaskCount > 0:
		return "Next: continue with the next ready item in your learning path.", "continue_learning_path"
	default:
		return "Next: start a short practical block aligned with the session goal.", "resume_goal_with_practice"
	}
}

func russianNextStep(analytics domain.LearningAnalyticsSummary) (string, string) {
	switch {
	case analytics.StuckSignalCount > 0 || analytics.FailureCount > analytics.PassedTestCount:
		return "Дальше: повтори сложный шаг и реши одно короткое похожее упражнение перед продолжением.", "stuck_or_failure_review"
	case analytics.HintCount > 0:
		return "Дальше: повтори похожее упражнение без подсказок, чтобы проверить самостоятельное понимание.", "verify_independent_understanding"
	case analytics.LessonCount+analytics.TaskCount > 0:
		return "Дальше: переходи к следующему готовому пункту своего learning path.", "continue_learning_path"
	default:
		return "Дальше: начни короткий практический блок по цели этого занятия.", "resume_goal_with_practice"
	}
}
